name: @superette/server-app
description: Serveur central FEDONIX 360 pour Windows : installateur, base intégrée et interface
author: FEDONG

scripts.build: electron-vite build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('../server/src/admin.page.html', 'out/main/admin.page.html'); fs.copyFileSync('../server/src/manager.page.html', 'out/main/manager.page.html'); fs.copyFileSync('../server/src/inventory.page.html', 'out/main/inventory.page.html'); for (const f of ['icon.ico', 'icon.png']) fs.copyFileSync('build/' + f, 'out/main/' + f)"
